scope: One synthetic posture, four shape/pose initialization factors; original procedure as separate reference. Every new case uses the same seed-independent objective and fixed hand/face/foot parameters.
gt_usage: True Head and generating cameras only in fitting. All body and WiLoR observations automatic. GT body/hand/shape used only for evaluation. Mean shape equals GT in this sample.
evaluation: Absolute camera-space errors except explicitly aligned fields. Same shared body in two cameras, not independent samples. Original saturation is relative to network; new-case saturation is absolute local angle.
